contradictions.title: Objection pursuant to Rule 111(3): Amending the Taxonomy Climate Delegated Act and the Taxonomy Disclosures Delegated Act

label.fr: Sortir des fossiles, garder le nucléaire comme transition
label.en: Exit fossil fuels, keep nuclear as a transition

explanation.fr: A voté l'objection visant à retirer le gaz et le nucléaire de la taxonomie des activités durables, alors que le programme garde le nucléaire comme énergie de transition ; l'acte visait aussi le gaz fossile, que le programme veut faire décliner.
explanation.en: Voted for the objection removing gas and nuclear from the EU taxonomy of sustainable activities, while the programme keeps nuclear as a transition energy; the act also covered fossil gas, which the programme wants to phase down.
